title: The evolution of private labels at retail
summary: This article discusses the historical development and current transformation of private label brands in retail. It highlights how private brands have gained significant consumer preference and outlines the reasons for their growth, as well as providing strategic recommendations for retailers and national brands to adapt to this evolving landscape. The author emphasizes the need for retailers to manage their private brands with the same sophistication as national brands.

title: Forrester Forecast: Online Retail Sales Will Grow To $250 Billion By 2014
summary: Forrester Research predicts that online retail sales in the U.S. will reach nearly $250 billion by 2014, growing at a 10 percent compound annual rate from $155 billion in 2009. The forecast highlights that while online sales are increasing, a significant portion of offline sales are influenced by online research, and retailers need to improve the in-store experience for Web-influenced customers.

title: UnitedHealth Building $100 Million Data Center
summary: UnitedHealth Group is planning to construct a new data center worth over $100 million in Chaska, Minnesota, partnering with Cisco to build a national telehealth network. The 190,000-square-foot facility is expected to be completed in 2012 and will enhance the company's data center capabilities, supporting IT initiatives like the eSync Platform for synchronizing healthcare records. The project is also poised to benefit the local economy through property taxes and power sales.

title: A $499 e-reader that opens like a book
summary: The article reviews the $499 Entourage Edge e-reader, highlighting its innovative dual-screen design with an e-ink display and a color touch screen. Despite its aspirations to replicate the book experience, the device is criticized for poor battery life, slow boot-up time, heavy weight, and an awkward user interface, especially when compared to competitors like the Kindle and the anticipated iPad.

title: EBay rebrands U.S. Kijiji site
summary: EBay Inc. is rebranding its U.S. classifieds business from Kijiji to eBayClassifieds.com, signaling a renewed effort to challenge Craigslist in the American market. This move includes launching new mobile applications and redesigning the website to leverage the stronger eBay brand, despite potential risks associated with linking the main brand to a venture that has struggled. Analysts view this as an aggressive step to dominate the U.S. classifieds space, but also acknowledge the increased risk to eBay's overall brand if the rebranding fails.
